description: This file defines data models for an online shopping application, specifically 'Category' and 'Product' data classes with associated utility functions.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model representing a catalog category with an ID and name.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model representing a product with various attributes including pricing, descriptions, images, and sale information.

methods.name: formattedPrice
methods.description: Returns the product price formatted as a currency string.

methods.name: formattedPriceFromCents
methods.description: Formats a given amount in cents as a currency string.

methods.name: hasMultipleImages
methods.description: Checks if the product has more than one image.

methods.name: effectiveLongDescription
methods.description: Returns a suitable long description for display, defaulting to the short description if the long one is blank.

methods.name: effectiveSalePriceCents
methods.description: Returns the sale price in cents if the product is on sale and the sale price is valid.

methods.name: effectiveDiscountPercent
methods.description: Calculates and returns the discount percentage based on sale and regular prices.

methods.name: hasSaleCountdown
methods.description: Determines if the sale has a countdown based on sale end time.

methods.name: remainingSaleMillis
methods.description: Calculates remaining milliseconds for the sale countdown if applicable.
